Name: Maple's Tolkien Paintings (The Lord of the Rings)
Author: maplepixel
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/173726358-1773669585.png[/img]

[b]CALLING ALL MIDDLE EARTH FANS! [/b]

I've gone back to the first mod I started working on, and I've finally finished it! I have replaced 26 of the paintings in the game with various designs inspired by The Lord of the Rings franchise.

You will hopefully recognise items, generic references, scenes and characters from the films. Full list below with new in-game names - [b]please note, to make names more identifiable for listing purposes, some of them have '[The]' [/b][b][i]after [/i]a word[/b][b] - the names will still be "The x" in-game.

They all appear correctly in the list when using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]﻿.[/b]

[i]Important info - I may look to replace more of the vanilla paintings in the future, so please let me know if you'd like to see more!
Please be aware that I may adjust one or two - for example, I am currently wondering if I feel I should change the design of 'Little Collection'. [/i]


Thank you for checking out this mod, I had so much fun making these. I hope you enjoy seeing paintings references a well-loved franchise in a well-loved game [img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/173726358-1772824653.png[/img]


Download and install both [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]/[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url].
Download "Maple's Tolkien paintings" and unzip the folder.
Place the unzipped folder into your Stardew Valley mods folder. 
﻿ ﻿﻿- [i]For Alternative Textures, use the 'Paintbucket' item from Robin's Store, left click on the painting and select your preferred design in the pop-up menu.
﻿ ﻿ ﻿Also compatible with the Retro Catalogue paintings.[/i]
...and hopefully you'll admire the decorations in the game!
